evidence.title: Evaluation of the CO2 Performance Ladder

implications_for_stage2_bounds.summary: The evidence supports narrowing the Stage 2 estimate from 2-12 MtCO2e/yr. Multiple sources converge on GPP delivering 4-15% emission reductions on affected procurement volumes, with construction materials showing the highest potential (up to 43%). For a representative country portfolio, the central estimate of ~5-8 MtCO2e/yr appears well-supported.
implications_for_stage2_bounds.lower_bound_support: The 1.3% annual reduction from the Dutch CO2 Ladder and 4% from ZEW suggest modest reductions (2-3 MtCO2e) are highly conservative but achievable even with weak implementation.
implications_for_stage2_bounds.upper_bound_support: ECOS's 19 MtCO2e EU construction potential and Ecologic's 14 MtCO2e German construction baseline suggest 10-12 MtCO2e is plausible for ambitious, comprehensive GPP across a major economy, supporting the upper end of the current range.
implications_for_stage2_bounds.central_tendency: Most measured outcomes cluster around 5-15% reduction on green-procured volumes. Given typical GPP adoption rates (not 100% of procurement), a realistic impact of 4-8 MtCO2e/yr for a G7-equivalent economy is supported by the evidence.
implications_for_stage2_bounds.recommended_narrowed_range: 3-10 MtCO2e/yr (tighter than current 2-12, supported by measured outcomes)

strongest_evidence: E03 (Dutch CO2 Ladder - measured annual reduction rates)
E04 (SPP Regions - measured CO2 from actual contracts)
E08 (UNIDO/IDDI - granular material-level data with baselines)
E10 (Wang et al. - peer-reviewed econometric with large sample)
weaker_evidence: E16 (Nordic - GPP effect not isolated from other policies)

world_bank.finding: Promotes GPP tools and frameworks for developing countries but no standardized tCO2e per spend metric published. Supports e-bus mandates and green building standards in specific projects.

unep_spp.finding: Monitors SDG 12.7.1 across 45+ countries. Uses ecolabels and EPDs for emission quantification. No single aggregate emission reduction figure published at global level.

uk_ppn_0621.finding: Mandates Carbon Reduction Plans for contracts >GBP 5M/yr since 2021. Requires Net Zero by 2050 commitment. No aggregate impact assessment published yet.
